spans.s:
(क, त) r. 10th cl. (अङ्कयति)
1 To number or count.
2 To mark.

n. (-ङ्कं)
1 A mark or spot.
2 The flank or part above the hips.
3 A species of dramatic entertainment.
4 The act of a play, &c.
5 Fault, offence.
6 A line, a stroke.
7 Mimic war or conflict.
8 Ornament, decoration.
9 Place, abode.
10 Proximity, proximate.
11 A chapter or section.
12 The body.
13 A cypher, an arithmetical sign.
E.
अञ्च to go, and the Uṇādi affix क; or अङ्क to stain or spot, अच् aff.

m. (-तिः)
1 A Brahman who maintains a sacred fire.
2 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
3

Fire.
4

Air, wind.
E.
अञ्च to go, and the Uṇādi aff. अति; च being changed to क.

n. (-नं)
1 Cyphering, writing or making cyphers.
2 Stamping, impressing, making marks.
E.
अङ्क to mark, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be marked.
2 To be numbered.
E.
अङ्क to mark, अनीयर् aff.

n. (-नं)
Turning on the side.
E.
अङ्क and परिवर्त्तन turning.

f. (-का)
An embrace, embracing.
E.
अङ्क the flank, and पालिका or पाली, nourishing.

f. (-ली)
1 An embrace, embracing.
2 A nurse.
3 A plant, (Piring or Medicago esculenta.)
E.
See अङ्कपालिका.

mfn. (-भाक्)
Resting or placed upon the side or hip.
E.
अङ्क and भाज् possessing.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be marked.
2 To be numbered.
E.
अङ्क to mark, तव्य aff.

f. (-द्या)
Arithmetic.
E.
अङ्क and विद्या science.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Marked, spotted.
2 Counted, numbered.
E.
अङ्क to mark, and participial aff. क्त.

f. (-की)
A small oblong drum.
E.
अङ्क the hip or flank, being carried upon that part.

m. (-टः)
A key.
E.
अकि to go, उटि aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A shoot or sprout.
2 The hair of the body.
3

Blood.
4

Water.
E.
अङ्क to stain, and Uṇādi aff. उरच्.

m. (-कः)
A nest.
E.
अङ्कुर a shoot, and कन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Budded, sprouted, germinated.
E.
अङ्कुर and इतच् aff.

mn. (-शः-शं)
The hook used to drive an elephant.
E.
अक to go, and उशच् Uṇādi aff. with नुम् inserted.

m. (-रः)
A sprout, a germin.
E.
See अङ्कुर, उ being made long.

mn. (-षः-षं)
The hook or goad for driving an elephant.
E.
See अङ्कुश, उ being made long.

m. (-हः)
An elephant-driver.
E.
अङ्कुश् —, and ग्रह who takes.

m. (-रः)
A restive elephant.
E.
अङ्कुश, and टुर् bad, difficult, धर who holds: who is ill restrained by the goad.

f. (-शी)
One of the twenty-four female deities peculiar to the Jainas, supposed to preside more immediately over human beings.
E.
अङ्कुश, and ङीप् fem. aff. having or holding a hook.

m. (-टः)
A plant: also अङ्कोठ.
E.
अङ्क to mark or stain, ओट aff.

m. (-ठः)
A plant, (Alangium hexapetalum.)
E.
See अङ्कोट, ठ being used for ट.

m. (-लः)
A plant. See अङ्कोट; also अङ्कालक.

m. (-रः)
A kind of poison, probably prepared from the plant अङ्कोल, or अंकोट.
E.
अङ्कोल, and सार essence.

f. (-का)
Embracing, an embrace.
E.
अङ्क the side, उत् pre. and ल, from ला, to take.

mfn. (-ङ्क्यः-ङ्क्या-ङ्क्यं)
1 To be counted.
2 To be marked.
m. (-ङ्क्यः)
A small oblong drum. See अङ्की.
E.
अङ्क to mark, aff. यत्; or अङ्क the hip, and य aff.

f. (-ङ्क्षी)
A musical instrument, a tabor.
